TEA_imported.provenance: imported from exp33_whitened_attr.json (recorded blocked-fold aggregate); NOT re-run through exp51's generic path, because the tea dictionary carries multi-component sets and mixtures

S1.rule: if whitening beats euclid on none of coverage / set size / abstention for at least half of the single-adulterant corpora, the metric claim is restricted to multi-atom dictionaries and those corpora become a geometry display only

S2.rule: whitened marginal coverage below 0.85, or a calibration pool below 20 spectra in any fold: report the interval and the pool size, do not quote the number as a guarantee

S3.rule: if the raw gauge cosine does not rank the whitening benefit across corpora (|rho| < 0.3), drop 'the dictionary condition number is a priori predictive' and report the benefit per corpus instead

S4.rule: any admissible corpus whose whitened naming MAF is worse (higher) than the euclidean one must be reported as a pair of curves, never as the favourable direction alone

S5.rule: a cluster-bootstrap interval on top-1 that covers the random-selection line must be written as 'not separable from chance', with no point estimate
